subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): expose anonymous Talk activity to plugins

question: Should plugins be permitted to observe all process-wide Talk activity, or must this SDK surface be restricted to the owning plugin/session or an explicit reviewed capability?
rationale: Payload redaction protects content but not cross-session presence and timing metadata; choosing a global observation policy is a product and security-boundary decision, not a mechanical implementation detail.

options.title: Require owner or session scope
options.body: Publish an observer only through the Talk handle or session that the plugin created, preventing unrelated plugins from learning activity timing.

options.title: Define a reviewed broad-observation capability
options.body: Keep a global observer only if maintainers intentionally define its trust model, permission declaration, and privacy contract.

options.title: Do not add this public surface
options.body: Leave ambient animation to plugin-owned sessions until a broadly supported Talk ownership model exists.

recommendation.title: Require owner or session scope
recommendation.body: Publish an observer only through the Talk handle or session that the plugin created, preventing unrelated plugins from learning activity timing.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa has the strongest direct history on the proposed Talk SDK surface and the adjacent merged session-controller refactor.
